// diagnostic

E0772

This call to {callee} matches more than one callable body

What

This call to {callee} matches more than one callable body

Why

The call's bare arguments and labels bind to multiple candidate signatures, so named arguments are required to deconflict them

Fix

Name the arguments to choose one candidate: {rewrite}

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0772: tests/ui/ambiguous_call_e0772.stderr.

Error [E0772]: this call to `put` matches more than one callable body
  --> tests/ui/ambiguous_call_e0772.jet:5:5
    |
  5 |     put("name", "text")
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the call binds to multiple candidate signatures:
  put(name: String, text: String)
  put(key: String, id: String)
 Fix: name the arguments to choose one candidate: `put(name: …, text: …)`
